messages:
claire: FYI I opened PR 8201 to add trace propagation examples for Console instrumentation and a short migration note for the YAML schema rename. Also fixed a dead anchor in the dashboards guide. Need reviewers for snippets + CI check.

tom: Nice! Which SDKs are you adding? We should cover at least Python + Go for parity with other quickstarts.

claire: Yes: Python and Go. The change is mostly showing how to attach trace metadata and include cost tags so dashboard rows can attribute tokens/costs. Also one YAML key rename: `traceKey` -> `trace_key`. Old embedded dashboards will still work but we want to document migration.

anita: Can you paste the snippets here so I can run them in the examples runner?

claire: Paste below. Python first:
```py
# Python (redwood==0.10)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))

client.attach_trace(trace_id='t-789', attrs={'route':'/v1/generate','model':'redwood-1'}, cost={'tokens':10})
# follow-up: client.generate(..., trace_context=client.current_trace())
```

and Go:
```go
// Go (module: github.com/redwood/inference-go)
import (
  "context"
  redwood "github.com/redwood/inference-go"
)

c := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
ctx := context.TODO()
ctx = redwood.WithTrace(ctx, redwood.Trace{ID: "t-789", Attrs: map[string]string{"route":"/v1/generate", "model":"redwood-1"}, Cost: redwood.Cost{Tokens: 10}})
// pass ctx into c.Generate(ctx, ...)
```

rob: Quick note: the Go example references WithTrace helper that was added in v0.4. Add a version callout. Also make sure the Python import path matches the packaged module (some older examples used `redwood_client`).

claire: Good call. I'll add a small "SDK version" tip on the snippet block.

docs-bot: link-checker: removed obsolete link /docs/dashboards#old-anchor and replaced with /docs/dashboards#row-mappings. Please confirm anchor locations.

anita: I ran both samples. Python works after adjusting import to match the package, Go needs a tiny fix: Cost struct field is `Tokens` (int64) not `Tokens` as string in my local. I'll patch the snippet.

tom: Migration note idea: include a two-line YAML compatibility example showing both keys, like
```yaml
# new
trace_key: "req-123"
# legacy
traceKey: "req-123"  # still supported but deprecated
```

claire: I like that. Also adding a CI lint that parses the YAML example and flags camelCase vs snake_case inconsistencies. Rob, can you add the docs-ci job?

rob: On it  I'll add a single-step job that runs `ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load_file("docs/examples/trace_sample.yaml")'` and `yq` schema lint. Won't block on flaky network.

anita: Accessibility nit: the dashboard screenshot needs descriptive alt text. I'll upload the image to /assets and give it alt text that describes the cost row mapping.

claire: Great. I'll update the PR with the version notes, compatibility YAML, fixed imports and alt text, and mark the PR description with `docs: tracehook-samples` so release notes can pick it up. Targeting merge tomorrow after CI.

tom: Approved from my side once CI job exists.

rob: CI job landed on a branch; will flip it into main on green.

anita: Verified examples render in the live runner and YAML parse job passes locally.

claire: Thanks all  merging after CI green. Will follow up with a changelog entry for the migration guide.
